text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine with Still in Love, 
who has been in a slump lately. After 
finishing our prayers, just as I was about 
to speak to her—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... I-I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Somehow... an unseen anxiety keeps 
crawling around... inside my body... and 
it's making me so uneasy...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Besides, ever since I lost my form... I've 
been causing you so much trouble, 
Trainer... I'm so, so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
B-But... I prayed very hard. I am certain 
things will take a turn for the better.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love puts on a forced, brave 
smile. In an effort to cheer her up, I 
tease her just a little—
choice_data_list: Well, you let out a sigh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I joked with a smile that happiness might 
escape. She looked uneasy for a moment, 
but seeing my smile, she seemed to realize 
it was just a joke.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...That is quite troubling. To think the 
happiness left inside me would slip 
away...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If I take a deep breath, do you think 
happiness will return to me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a cue from Still in Love, who took 
a deep breath as if doing warm-up 
stretches, I took a deep breath myself.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I really can't tell. And there's 
no way to confirm it right away, either...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Or... did they end up running away inside 
you, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, I involuntarily took a deep 
breath along with her... As I stood 
flustered, Still in Love chuckled."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... As long as it remains in your 
heart, Trainer, there's no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
My little piece of happiness... I'm sure 
it will grow bigger and bigger through 
your strength...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that... just being near you. 
...Just being by your side."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love deserves to be happier... 
than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love wore an expression of 
conviction at her own words. Having wiped 
away her anxiety, her condition seemed to 
have fully returned.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... Whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: *cough*...! *hack*, *gasp*... *cough*...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuu... I... accidentally inhaled... a 
tiny leaf...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It seems the happiness that slipped 
away... no longer wished to be caught by 
me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love was visibly crestfallen. 
Unfortunately, it seemed she wasn't able 
to regain her motivation...
